title: Historie smb AAPS (3.2.0.1) does not match historie Pump (Combo)
symptom: After restarting the phone, the SMB history in AAPS does not match the pump history. AAPS shows an SMB at 20:01 (0.5 U) and at 20:07 (0.3 U), while the pump shows an additional SMB at 20:01 (0.3 U). The user did not manually initiate any bolus.
cause: The logs do not show what happened before 20:05, but it is suspected that the Combo recorded the 'standard bolus requested' event but not the 'standard bolus infused' one, which would explain the discrepancy.
fix: The user was advised to increase the number of logs to 5 in Maintenance Settings to capture more details next time, and to send logs immediately if the issue recurs. No definitive fix was provided.
evidence_quote: I suspect though that perhaps for some reason the Combo recorded the "standard bolus requested" event but not the "standard bolus infused" one.
